'''Bravo Five''' was the callsign of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

[[Dineé Ellberger/Legends|Dineé Ellberger]] served as Bravo Five around the time of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], and survived that conflict.
